purpose: Reference LeafCutter pseudobulk DS result. Compare LeafletFA group DS (differential_splicing_groups.py) against these numbers on the same contrast.

design.note: Every donor contributes one pseudobulk sample to EACH group, so age and sex are exactly balanced across the contrast and cannot confound it.

what_leafletfa_should_reproduce: Sign and rough magnitude of delta_psi per junction (skip ~ +0.90 endothelial over fibroblast).
The ATSE ranking near the top of this contrast.
Report the SLOPE of LeafletFA beta on these deltas, not the correlation -- correlation is scale-invariant and hides attenuation.
Consistency across all 13 donors and all 3 age groups -- if LeafletFA imputed PSI shows the cell-type split only at some ages, that is a red flag.

age_consistency.method: Paired per-donor delta PSI (endothelial - fibroblast), n=13 donors, regressed on age in months; Kruskal-Wallis across 3m/18m/24m.

include_5p.verdict: modest age-dependent attenuation; POST-HOC on a hand-picked top ATSE, treat as a lead not a finding

caveats: This ATSE was selected for being a top hit, so any age trend here is post-hoc and uncorrected across the ~9,700 tested ATSEs in this contrast.
age was a covariate in the LeafCutter model, so the reported p_adjust is already adjusted for it.
